notes: status: engine = already in src/levels.js; new-level = attached to a new level using an existing sim.questRules type (no code); needs-code = new type (fragile, speedtrap, statGoal) or skin field. statGoal reads sim.stat keys (flips, rolls, loops, carJumps, nearMiss, perfect, maxAir, gaps, drift, maxSpeed). Rewards are coins (= quest.reward) plus xp for a player-level bar.

triggers.levelStart: quest is active when the level loads (current sim behaviour)
triggers.proximity: starts when the player reaches the pickup (sim pizza/deliver/rover)
triggers.afterStars: offered on the level card once that level has >= N stars
triggers.baseVisit: offered by a character at a base building

objective.name: Mailbox Mayhem
objective.text: Smash 8 roadside mailboxes

dialogue.intro: Those mailboxes have been sending me spam for years. Do what you must.
dialogue.success: Finally, peace and quiet. And no more catalogues.
dialogue.fail: The mailboxes win this round.

objective.name: Pizza Express
objective.text: Grab the pizza and deliver it before it goes cold

dialogue.intro: Thirty-two seconds or it is free. And I do not do free.
dialogue.success: Hot, crispy, slightly airborne. Perfetto!
dialogue.fail: Cold pizza. A tragedy in one act.

objective.name: Donut Dunk
objective.text: Fly through the giant donut billboard

dialogue.intro: Fly through the donut. I would, but I would eat it.
dialogue.success: Sprinkles everywhere. Magnificent.
dialogue.fail: You missed the donut. The donut is disappointed.

objective.name: Runaway Cow
objective.text: Catch Bessie the runaway cow

dialogue.intro: Bessie saw the ocean and just... went. Bring her home!
dialogue.success: Moo! (Bessie says thank you and also moo.)
dialogue.fail: Bessie is now a beach cow. Forever.

objective.name: Lost Luggage
objective.text: Collect 6 suitcases that fell off a roof rack

dialogue.intro: I strapped six suitcases to my roof. In hindsight, with string.
dialogue.success: All six! Even the one full of socks!
dialogue.fail: Somewhere out there, my socks are free.

objective.name: Hoop Dreams
objective.text: Fly through the flaming hoop above the Loop Launcher

dialogue.intro: The flaming hoop! Safety rating: technically legal.
dialogue.success: Through the fire! The crowd goes mild! I mean wild!
dialogue.fail: You went around the hoop. That is called driving.

objective.name: Lighthouse Pizza
objective.text: The lighthouse keeper ordered a large pepperoni. Deliver it hot

dialogue.intro: Large pepperoni. The bridge is out, but I believe in you.
dialogue.success: It flew over the sea and it is still hot? Marry me. No. Tip accepted.
dialogue.fail: The seagulls got it. They always get it.

quests.name: Runaway Robot

objective.name: Runaway Robot
objective.text: Catch B0LT, the delivery robot that ran off with your charger cable

dialogue.intro: B0LT: I AM NOT RUNNING. I AM RELOCATING. WITH YOUR CABLE.
dialogue.success: B0LT: FINE. HERE IS YOUR CABLE. I WAS GOING TO RETURN IT. EVENTUALLY.
dialogue.fail: B0LT: SEE YOU NEVER, HUMAN. (beep)

quests.needsCode: cow logic reused; render B0LT model when quest.skin==="robot", emit "beep" instead of "moo"

objective.name: Cheese Survey
objective.text: Collect 6 moon-cheese samples (science says yes)

dialogue.intro: Science has never proven the Moon is not cheese. Collect samples.
dialogue.success: Results: 100% cheese. Peer review pending.
dialogue.fail: Inconclusive. Also hungry.

objective.name: Polar Ice Run
objective.text: Haul a block of crater ice to the base before the sun melts it

dialogue.intro: Crater ice for the coffee machine. This is a mission-critical latte.
dialogue.success: Latte secured. You are a hero of the outpost.
dialogue.fail: It sublimated. Into space. Like my hopes.

objective.name: Alien Hitchhiker
objective.text: Pick up the alien and drop it at its UFO

dialogue.intro: Zorp: Greetings. My saucer is parked over there. Also I ate your snacks.
dialogue.success: Zorp: Five stars. Would be abducted by you again.
dialogue.fail: Zorp: I will simply teleport. Bye, slow earthling.

objective.name: Core Sampler
objective.text: Collect 6 glowing core samples (NOT for eating)

dialogue.intro: They glow. They hum. Please do not lick them.
dialogue.success: Six cores! Only one is humming ominously.
dialogue.fail: The cores are now part of the abyss. Science weeps.

objective.name: Space Donut
objective.text: Fly through the orbital donut

dialogue.intro: They sent me to space. For donuts. I regret nothing.
dialogue.success: A donut in zero g. Truly the final frontier.
dialogue.fail: The donut drifts on without you.

objective.name: Buggy Selfie
objective.text: Stop next to the abandoned moon buggy for a 2 second selfie

dialogue.intro: Vintage moon buggy, Earthrise, you. Hold still for two seconds. Content!
dialogue.success: #MoonLife #NoFilter #NoAtmosphere
dialogue.fail: Blurry. Unfollowing.

objective.name: Earthrise Hoop
objective.text: Thread the giant hoop at the apex of the Earthrise jump

dialogue.intro: Biggest hoop, biggest jump, biggest view. Do not look down. Or do, it is pretty.
dialogue.success: Eleven seconds of air and a hoop! Legend!
dialogue.fail: You missed a hoop the size of a stadium. Impressive, in a way.

objective.name: Martian Farmer
objective.text: Collect 6 lost potatoes

dialogue.intro: I am going to have to science the potatoes out of this. Help me find them.
dialogue.success: Six potatoes! That is a whole sol of dinner.
dialogue.fail: Ketchup without potatoes. The saddest condiment.

objective.name: Antenna Bits
objective.text: Collect 6 pieces of a lander antenna (some assembly required)

dialogue.intro: L-7: Antenna detached. Cannot stream my favourite show. Please assist.
dialogue.success: L-7: Signal restored. Episode 4,812 resumes.
dialogue.fail: L-7: Static. Only static.

objective.name: Rover Reunion
objective.text: Stop next to the lonely rover for 2 seconds

dialogue.intro: beep... boop... (it has been alone for a long time)
dialogue.success: BEEP BEEP! (happiest rover on Mars)
dialogue.fail: boop. (sad)

objective.name: Runaway Dust-Bot
objective.text: Catch the panicking cleaning robot before it vacuums the whole planet

dialogue.intro: Dust-Bot: SO. MUCH. DUST. I MUST CLEAN IT ALL. FAREWELL.
dialogue.success: Dust-Bot: Thank you. I will start with one crater at a time.
dialogue.fail: Dust-Bot has vacuumed itself into a dune.

quests.name: Canyon Pizza

objective.name: Canyon Pizza
objective.text: Deliver a pizza across the canyon without spilling it (no crashes!)

dialogue.intro: Across the canyon. No spilling. The toppings are very nervous.
dialogue.success: Not one olive out of place. You are an artist.
dialogue.fail: Pizza face-down in the regolith. Mars-gherita.

quests.needsCode: quest.noCrash: fail pizza/deliver on crash() or land strength > 0.85

objective.name: Ice Core Express
objective.text: Rush an ice core to the base before it melts

dialogue.intro: This ice core is 3 billion years old and melting in 50 seconds. No pressure.
dialogue.success: Still frozen! History preserved!
dialogue.fail: 3 billion years, ruined in your cup holder.

objective.name: Rover Ride-Along
objective.text: Stop by the lost rover for 2 seconds so it can hitch a lift home

dialogue.intro: Pebble: My wheels are tired. Can I ride on your roof? I promise not to drill anything.
dialogue.success: Pebble: Wheee! Best. Field trip. Ever.
dialogue.fail: Pebble: I will just roll home. Slowly. Over 14 years.

objective.text: Deliver a dozen eggs over the canyons. Land softly (no hard landings).

dialogue.intro: Twelve eggs, three canyons, zero excuses, sweetie.
dialogue.success: Not a single crack! Have a cookie. Have six.
dialogue.fail: Well, now we are having omelettes.

objective.text: Pass the speed camera at 80 m/s (288 km/h) for the perfect blurry photo

dialogue.intro: SC-9: I have photographed 4 million cars. None were interesting.
dialogue.success: SC-9: Finally. Art.
dialogue.fail: SC-9: Just another sedan. Yawn.

objective.text: Hit a 1971-style moon golf shot: stay airborne 8 seconds to "drive" the ball

dialogue.intro: Fore! In one-sixth gravity, the ball goes miles and miles.
dialogue.success: Hole in one! It landed in a crater. Same thing.
dialogue.fail: Mulligan. Nobody saw. Except everyone.

objective.text: DJ Phobos needs 4 flips or rolls in 40 s to drop the beat

dialogue.intro: Every flip is a beat. Every roll is a bass drop. Make it rain dust!
dialogue.success: The whole colony is dancing! Even the potatoes!
dialogue.fail: Tough crowd. Martians do not clap, they just stare.

objective.text: Your charger robot Juice is sulking. Do 5 loops in one run to cheer it up

dialogue.intro: Juice: Nobody notices me. I just charge. And charge. Sigh.
dialogue.success: Juice: Five loops? For ME? I am charging with joy!
dialogue.fail: Juice: It is fine. I am fine. (it is not fine)

objective.text: Jump 5 cars while carrying an "URGENT" parcel

dialogue.intro: Traffic is the enemy. The sky is free. You get the idea.
dialogue.success: Delivered by air! Signature not required.
dialogue.fail: Stuck in traffic like a normal person. Ew.
